name: osleaders
description: A Discord bot for small private Old School RuneScape communities.

scripts.test:integration: npm run db:test:reset -- --confirm osleaders_test && npm run db:test:migrate && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.test ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run test:integration
